title: Frontiers of Information Integrity in Climate Change
discussion_signal: The post says climate information interventions remain weighted toward detecting and responding to harmful content, with less emphasis on prevention, trust rebuilding, and long-term resilience. linked_research_question: Which information interventions rebuild trust and climate-action legitimacy instead of only reacting to harmful narratives?
